title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Chat History Landing page: Filtering UI Refresh
description: To help you quickly find the conversations that matter, we’re updating the Chat History filtering experience. This refresh makes the interface simpler and makes it easier to clear filters whenever you need to.
